tests.name: One machine, one employee
tests.expected: net 1 h, gross 1 h, PLH 300/300

tests.name: One machine, two employees
tests.expected: labour 2 h, PLH 150

tests.name: One machine, three employees
tests.expected: labour 6 h, PLH 100

tests.name: Multiple products on one machine
tests.expected: 2 jobs; job A = 300/4 = 75 PLH; B = 200

tests.name: Employee changes machine
tests.input: Bob V1 08:00-08:30 then V2 08:30-09:00; Ann V1, Cy V2 all hour
tests.expected: 3 people x 60 = 180 person-min; V1 90, V2 90
tests.note: Headcount-driven; correct only if operators update the crew count at the moment of the move.

tests.name: Break during production (30 min paid)
tests.expected: net 300 min (5 h); gross 360 min (6 h); durationMin 150; BREAK record 30

tests.name: Downtime during a production session
tests.expected: net 180 min, gross 240 min; gross PLH 67.5, net 90; WAITING record 30 min

tests.name: Multiple downtime categories
tests.input: run 80 min x2; WAIT upstream 20, CHANGEOVER 15, PLANNED 10, NO_WORK 25
tests.expected: net 160; gross 160+(20+15+10)x2 = 250 (NO_WORK unpaid); report RUN 80, WAIT 20 (upstream 20), CHG 15, PLANNED 10, NO_WORK 25

tests.name: Zero production
tests.expected: PLH NOT CALCULABLE (null); excluded from PLH totals; listed as incomplete
tests.actual: grossPLH null, netPLH null, in PLH 0, incomplete 1

tests.name: Missing production weight
tests.expected: weight stays missing (not 0 production); summary PLH NOT CALCULABLE
tests.note: App stores blank weight as 0 (flag via grossPLH null only). computePLHSummary returns 0, not null, when there are no hours; the card hides it when there are 0 jobs, but the number itself is 0 rather than NOT CALCULABLE.

tests.name: Missing labour information (0-minute run with weight)
tests.expected: record kept and flagged NOT CALCULABLE (weight must not be lost)
tests.note: closeOutLiveRun drops the RUNNING record when every segment is 0 min, so the entered weight is silently discarded.

tests.name: Combined job with 0 labour hours
tests.input: two runs same job, 100 lb each, 0 h
tests.expected: grossPLH NOT CALCULABLE (null)
tests.note: groupPLHJobs sets grossPLH 0 (invented) but netPLH null - inconsistent; a 0 shows as the "Lowest Product".

tests.name: Duplicate production record
tests.input: same V1 run 08-09, 300 lb saved twice
tests.expected: counted once (300 lb) or flagged
tests.actual: total lbs 600, hours 4, report RUNNING 120 min
tests.note: No duplicate detection in PLH, reports or Live close-out; only manual entry warns about overlaps (confirmNoOverlap).

tests.name: Same live run finished from two devices
tests.input: device 2 still holds the open run
tests.expected: 1 RUNNING record
tests.note: Matches real pair rmun962e9fxde0 / rmunczuu2080b3 (2026-09-29 V1).

tests.name: Edited production record (finish 12:00 -> 11:00)
tests.expected: durationMin 150; net 300 min; gross 360 min; PLH 700/6 = 116.67
tests.note: Weight is kept unchanged after shortening the run - correct only if the weight really belongs to the shorter window.

tests.name: Edit recalculation uses same paid-break rule
tests.input: two runs, each with a 30-min break (only 30 paid per line per day); edit run 2
tests.expected: run 2 gross after edit = 160 (no paid break left)
tests.note: recalcLiveRunRecord gives the edited run a fresh 30 paid minutes; render() later re-applies the rule in memory, so the stored and shown gross can differ.

tests.name: Deleted production record
tests.input: report saved with 2 runs, then one deleted
tests.expected: saved and viewed report agree, or the change is flagged
tests.note: Report view silently recomputes from current records; the saved snapshot (possibly already sent) is never compared. Real case: 2026-10-05 (18 records gone).

tests.name: Daily aggregation
tests.input: V1 RUN 120 + BREAK 30; V2 BREAK 30 + WAIT up 30; MP WAIT int 20; Fajita side RUN 60
tests.expected: RUN 120, WAIT 50 (up 30 / int 20), recordCount 5 (side excluded), most waiting V2 30
tests.note: Department BREAK 30 = clock minutes (overlapping breaks merged) while machine BREAK totals add to 60: the two are not additive. Fajita (side) is omitted from the daily report without any note.

tests.name: Weekly aggregation
tests.expected: weekly = 1300/9 = 144.44 (not mean 300)

tests.name: Monthly aggregation
tests.expected: a calendar-month (1st to last day) report
tests.actual: no monthly report in app; presets: 30days 2026-10-20..2026-11-18, thisWeek 2026-11-16..2026-11-18
tests.note: Only rolling "Last 30 days" and custom ranges exist. A calendar month can be entered manually as a custom range in Weekly Summary; the PLH maths there is pooled (correct).

tests.name: Department-wide aggregation
tests.expected: lines dept = 600/4 = 150 PLH; side reported separately (150 lb, 1 h)
tests.actual: lines 600 lb / 4 h = 150; side 150 lb / 1 h

tests.name: Manual Pack and side-machine production in Daily Report
tests.expected: Manual Pack in report; side machine shown or explicitly noted as excluded
tests.actual: perMachine keys Variovac 1, Variovac 2, Variovac 3, Manual Pack; RUNNING 120
tests.note: Manual Pack is included. Side machines are excluded from daily/weekly reports by design (v157) with no note on the report itself.

tests.name: Record crossing midnight
tests.expected: flagged / handled as 120 min
tests.note: App assumes a day shift: crossing midnight gives 0 min; the repair sets the end equal to the start (0 min). Acceptable for a single day shift only.

tests.name: Downtime overlapping another state
tests.expected: 55 clock minutes on V1, overlap flagged
tests.note: Reports never check overlaps; 30 min counted twice. Real cases on 2026-08-19, 08-21, 09-01, 09-15, 09-29.

tests.name: Planned stop entered as Waiting "Other"
tests.expected: counted as planned (excluded from bottlenecks/efficiency)
tests.note: Free text under Waiting is ranked as a bottleneck; 77 real records (797 min) of Crew Talk / Metal Detector / Town Hall / Stretching are WAITING.

tests.name: Rounding: no early rounding
tests.expected: 205.7088 stored unrounded
tests.note: Stored hours and PLH are full-precision; rounding happens only in display (toFixed).
